components.name: MemoryRepository
components.description: Core data access layer for memory CRUD operations using ObjectBox database. Supports per-profile isolation. Implements vector similarity search with RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) combining semantic and keyword search. Includes link graph operations (strong/medium/weak relations), tag system, document chunk management, folder-based organization, and memory import/export.
key_features: Hybrid search: semantic embedding + keyword coverage bonus with RRF
Link/graph relationships with configurable weights (STRONG=1.0, MEDIUM=0.7, WEAK=0.3)
Document chunk storage and retrieval via DocumentChunk entities
Memory score modes and debug info for search transparency

components.name: Memory Entity
components.description: Core memory unit entity stored in ObjectBox. Represents a knowledge fragment/event/concept. Contains title, content, contentType, source, credibility, importance, documentPath, isDocumentNode, chunkIndexFilePath, folderPath, embedding (FloatArray), tags, links, backlinks, properties, documentChunks, and timestamps.
relations: documentChunks: ToMany<DocumentChunk> - full document content blocks

components.name: MemoryLink Entity
components.description: Directed relationship between memories with weight (strong/medium/weak) and description. Forms a knowledge graph.

components.name: MemoryTag Entity
components.description: Tag for memory classification with parent-child hierarchy support

components.name: VectorIndexManager
components.description: HNSWLib-based vector index. Uses cosine similarity distance. Supports dynamic resizing, item removal, k-nearest-neighbor query, persistence via Java serialization to disk.

components.name: IndexItem
components.description: Concrete Item implementation for HNSWLib storing id, vector (FloatArray), and associated data

components.name: MemoryLibrary
components.description: High-level memory management API. Analyzes conversation content via AI to extract structured knowledge graph: entities (ParsedEntity), relationships (ParsedLink), updates (ParsedUpdate), merges (ParsedMerge), and user preferences. Persists extracted knowledge as memory nodes with links in ObjectBox.

analysis_output_structure.extractedEntities: List of knowledge items with title, content, tags, aliasFor, folderPath
analysis_output_structure.updates: Content updates for existing entities with credibility/importance changes

components.name: MemoryAutoSaveScheduler
components.description: Periodic background service that scans chat histories for memory-worthy content. Polls every 60s, extracts candidates from conversations (reply finalization, user messages), batches them (max 48 messages/run), and processes via MemoryAutoSaveCandidateRepository.

components.name: MemoryAutoSaveCandidateRepository
components.description: Manages queue of memory extraction candidates with status tracking: PENDING, PROCESSING, FAILED. Supports state_machine transitions for retry logic.

components.name: MemorySearchSettingsPreferences
components.description: Per-profile memory search settings: auto-save interval, next scheduled run timestamp, search configuration

components.name: Embedding / EmbeddingConverter
components.description: FloatArray-based embedding vector stored in ObjectBox via converter (ByteArray storage)

components.name: CloudEmbeddingService
components.description: Service for computing embeddings via cloud API providers (uses configured model endpoint)

components.name: DocumentChunk Entity
components.description: Stores segmented document content for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) - full document text split into searchable chunks with embeddings

components.name: MemoryDocumentsProvider
components.description: Android DocumentsProvider exposing memory contents to the system file picker (SAF)

components.name: MemorySearchConfig / MemorySearchDebugInfo
components.description: Configuration and debug instrumentation for search relevance scoring

storage.primary: ObjectBox (NoSQL embedded database) per memory profile
storage.vector_index: HNSWLib (hnswlib) Hierarchical Navigable Small World graph with cosine distance
storage.vector_persistence: Java Object serialization to disk file
storage.supabase: No evidence of Supabase pgvector found

details: Operit v1.12.0 has a sophisticated memory system built on three pillars: (1) ObjectBox-based persistent knowledge graph with entities, directed weighted links, tags, folder hierarchy, and full document RAG chunk storage; (2) HNSWLib vector index enabling cosine-similarity semantic search fused with keyword coverage bonus via RRF; (3) AI-powered memory extraction pipeline that analyzes conversations to auto-extract entities, relationships, updates, and merges. The system supports per-profile isolation so different character cards can have separate memory stores. MemoryDocumentsProvider exposes stored memories to Android's Storage Access Framework.
notes: Memory profiles are isolated per character card via profileId
Search uses RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) with k=60 and keyword coverage bonus of 0.6
Memory graph supports three link strengths: 1.0 (strong), 0.7 (medium), 0.3 (weak)
Auto-save scheduler runs in background with configurable interval
Cloud embeddings are computed via the model provider configured for the profile
MemoryLibrary uses AI to extract structured knowledge from raw conversation text
MemoryImportResult supports various import strategies (merge, replace, skip)
The system supports memory export for backup/transfer
